problem_statement: Return the number of pairs (i, j) with i < j such that values[i] + values[j] is even. values is any Python list of integers (excluding bool), including an empty list. Do not modify the input.
valid_input_domain: Return the number of pairs (i, j) with i < j such that values[i] + values[j] is even. values is any Python list of integers (excluding bool), including an empty list. Do not modify the input.
bug_explanation: The faulty solution uses range(i + 2, n) instead of range(i + 1, n), so adjacent pairs (j = i + 1) are never checked.
